posts.title: Amnesty International's Taken-Down Article on the UK Anti-Rights Movement
posts.description: JKR has forced Amnesty International into retracting and apologising for a report into the anti-rights movement in the UK. I am reposting a copy here (which is also available via the Internet Archive).

posts.title: Sphinx of Black Quartz, Judge my Vow!
posts.description: Type design needs something better than a quick brown fox. Specifically, we need word lists that demonstrate pairs of letter forms efficiently.

posts.title: Go has some tricks up its logging sleeve
posts.description: The Go programming language has some subtle capabilities that make it possible to take logging, and therefore tracing and debugging, further than most other languages.
